name: DistToNearestPoint
formula: =LAMBDA(queryX,queryY,xCoords,yCoords,MIN(BYROW(SEQUENCE(ROWS(xCoords)), LAMBDA(i, {ref}Dist(queryX, queryY, CHOOSEROWS(xCoords, i), CHOOSEROWS(yCoords, i))))))
comment: Returns the Euclidean distance from `(queryX, queryY)` to the nearest point in arrays `xCoords` and `yCoords`, via [[Dist]]. Handles empty/mismatched arrays with NA().
